title.narrative: Improve access to integrated, quality and lifesaving healthcare and WASH services for the drought affected populations in Hargeisa District.

description.narrative: ltpgtAlight’s proposed Integrated health and WASH programming will be implemented in close coordination and collaboration with respective Government bodies, including Somaliland MOHD, Federal Ministry of Health, UN Partners such as WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA, WFP, SHF partners, and other health cluster and ABC partners. Alight will focus its interventions on the provision of primary healthcare services and through the existing health 8-facilities and WASH services to Improve access to equitable, safe, and quality lifesaving health services integrated with WASH services for the vulnerable population to reduce excess morbidity and mortality, prepare, prevent, detect, and ensure timely response to epidemic-prone and endemic diseases driven by climatic shock in Hargeisa district of Maroodi Jeex region. The project will serve populations in drought-affected hotspot areas in Hargeisa's rural locations, including (Adan Abokor, Bali Cabane, Bali-Mataan, Bender Wanaa, Caydarosh, Dacarta, Darar Weyne, Dhimbil Riya, Faraweyne, Gumar, Salaxley, Sayla Bari, Waddo Makaah.) villages. It aims to benefit 144,130 individuals (46,122 women, 37,474 men, 31,708 girls, and 28,826 boys), with an emphasis on gender equality.ltbrgtTo mitigate increased vulnerability caused by drought and reliance on limited WASH resources, the project will promote equitable and sustainable access to safe drinking water by rehabilitating water sources and providing emergency water trucking. Efforts will be made to improve gender-sensitive access to water, specifically for water kiosks by constructing ramps and handrails for people with disabilities and the elderly. Additional adaptations will be implemented on a case-by-case basis to ensure accessibility.ltbrgtBoth hardware (infrastructure) activities will be integrated to maximize impact. WASH committees will be trained. These measures aim to ensure the sustainability of WASH infrastructure and services, ultimately improving public health outcomes in the targeted areas. The partners will maintain ongoing coordination with government agencies, the WASH cluster, and technical working groups to ensure continued operation and maintenance of services after project completion.ltbrgtThe health components will enhance the provision of life-saving primary health care services through 8 fixed facilities through the essential package of health services (EPHS), such as clinical care, child health care, referrals, immunization, communicable disease treatment, emergency treatment, and treatment for communicable and non-communicable diseases. ALIGHT will provide Prepositioning and provision of essential medicines and supplies to support facilities. The project will ensure the provision of sexual and reproductive health services (ANC, PNC, safe deliveries, dignity kits for pregnant mothers, and referral mechanisms, and improve access to trauma care services. ALIGHT teams will provide basic mental health/psychosocial services and referrals, enhance Infection Prevention and Control (IPC), and undertake health awareness, social mobilization, education, and advocacy activities in disease control and the general well-being, including PSEA, health through CHWs or other mechanisms like key informants. ltbrgtlt/pgt
